classes.name: IGESGeom_BSplineCurve
classes.summary: defines IGESBSplineCurve, Type <126> Form <0-5> in package {@link IGESGeom | `IGESGeom`} A parametric equation obtained by dividing two summations involving weights (which are real numbers), the control points, and B-Spline basis functions

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (anIndex: number, aDegree: number, aPlanar: boolean, aClosed: boolean, aPolynom: boolean, aPeriodic: boolean, allKnots: NCollection_HArray1_double, allWeights: NCollection_HArray1_double, allPoles: NCollection_HArray1_gp_XYZ, aUmin: number, aUmax: number, aNorm: gp_XYZ): void
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class BSplineCurve. Beware about indexation of arrays.
- anIndex : Upper index of the sum
- aDegree : Degree of basis functions
- aPlanar : 0 = nonplanar curve, 1 = planar curve
- aClosed : 0 = open curve, 1 = closed curve
- aPolynom : 0 = rational, 1 = polynomial
- aPeriodic : 0 = nonperiodic, 1 = periodic
- allKnots : Knot sequence values [-Degree,Index+1]
- allWeights : Array of weights [0,Index]
- allPoles : X, Y, Z coordinates of all control points [0,Index]
- aUmin, aUmax : Starting and ending parameter values
- aNorm : Unit normal (if the curve is planar) raises exception if allWeights & allPoles are not of same size.

instanceMethods.name: SetFormNumber
instanceMethods.comment: Changes FormNumber (indicates the Shape of the Curve) Error if not in range [0-5].

instanceMethods.name: UpperIndex
instanceMethods.comment: returns the upper index of the sum (see Knots,Poles)

instanceMethods.name: Degree
instanceMethods.comment: returns the degree of basis functions

instanceMethods.name: IsPlanar
instanceMethods.comment: returns True if the curve is Planar, False if non-planar

instanceMethods.name: IsClosed
instanceMethods.comment: returns True if the curve is closed, False if open

instanceMethods.name: IsPolynomial
instanceMethods.comment: returns True if the curve is polynomial, False if rational <flag> False (D) : computed from the list of weights (all must be equal) <flag> True : as recorded

instanceMethods.name: IsPeriodic
instanceMethods.comment: returns True if the curve is periodic, False otherwise

instanceMethods.name: NbKnots
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of knots (i.e. Degree + UpperIndex + 2)

instanceMethods.name: Knot
instanceMethods.comment: returns the knot referred to by anIndex, inside the range [-Degree,UpperIndex+1] raises exception if anIndex < -`Degree()` or anIndex > (`NbKnots()` - `Degree()`) Note : Knots are numbered from -Degree (not from 1)

instanceMethods.name: NbPoles
instanceMethods.comment: returns number of poles (i.e. UpperIndex + 1)

instanceMethods.name: Weight
instanceMethods.comment: returns the weight referred to by anIndex, in [0,UpperIndex] raises exception if anIndex < 0 or anIndex > `UpperIndex()`

instanceMethods.name: Pole
instanceMethods.comment: returns the pole referred to by anIndex, in [0,UpperIndex] raises exception if anIndex < 0 or anIndex > `UpperIndex()`

instanceMethods.name: TransformedPole
instanceMethods.comment: returns the anIndex'th pole after applying Transf. Matrix raises exception if an Index < 0 or an Index > `UpperIndex()`

instanceMethods.name: UMin
instanceMethods.comment: returns starting parameter value

instanceMethods.name: UMax
instanceMethods.comment: returns ending parameter value

instanceMethods.name: Normal
instanceMethods.comment: if the curve is nonplanar then (0, 0, 0) is returned

classes.name: IGESGeom_ConicArc
classes.summary: defines IGESConicArc, Type <104> Form <0-3> in package {@link IGESGeom | `IGESGeom`} A conic arc is a bounded connected portion of a parent conic curve which consists of more than one point. The parent conic curve is either an ellipse, a parabola, or a hyperbola. The definition space coordinate system is always chosen so that the conic arc lies in a plane either coincident with or parallel to XT, YT plane. Within such a plane a conic is defined by the six coefficients in the following equation. A*XT^2 + B*XT*YT + C*YT^2 + D*XT + E*YT + F = 0
